# Third-party images that CI pulls, copied to ghcr.io/cacti/ci-images/ by
# .github/workflows/ci-images.yml so jobs pull them with GITHUB_TOKEN instead
# of as anonymous clients of Docker Hub or public.ecr.aws.
#
# Format: <source>@sha256:<digest> <destination name>:<tag>
#
# The copy keeps the source digest, so a workflow that pins a digest today
# keeps the same digest after it switches to the GHCR name. To bump an image,
# change the digest here and in every workflow that pins it in the same PR.
# The tag names the upstream release the digest was taken from.

docker.io/library/mariadb@sha256:2fdc84794931c0abde9ba6a8c9cb5a4635a02d851a103f0301a8b606dfc5cd98 mariadb:10.6
